scope: Mako native RGBA atlas, immutable metadata and pure driving controller. In-game integration is a separate gate.

nativeReview.method: Chromium 1:1 1536x1024 CSS checkerboard, screenshot opened with view_image; source PNG unchanged.
observations: Four complete separated Mako views: front, rear, left and right.
Three visible near-side wheels in both profile views; six-wheel ME1 silhouette preserved.
No vehicle or barrel clipped at render alpha threshold. No studio halo visible on checkerboard.
Surface details, wheel/turret offsets and unobserved angles remain generated interpretations.

technical.thresholdQualification: Analysis at alpha>40 (.16) is more permissive than the observed world material .2, so the zero-outside-frame check also covers that higher rendering threshold.

cases: bounded acceleration, boost, inertia and frame dt
safe foot dismount paths and refusal across thin enclosing wall
untrusted state/input/time and missing collision callback
immutable validated metadata with malformed UV/media rejection

primaryReference.actuallyOpened: Rendered PDF page13 via pdftoppm, opened with view_image. Extracted CMYK JPEG preview also opened; rendered page is correct-color generation reference.
facts: Approach to enter; safe stable ground before exit.
Manual documents cannon, machine gun, jump and omni-gel repair; those systems are not implemented by this controller.
limits: Single small terrain perspective, no complete orthographic reference, no canonical speed or collision dimensions established.

gates.inGameDriving: Owned by frontier level/UI integration; not claimed by this art report.

limitations: Transient renderer state; parked Mako reset on zone reload and campaign resumes on foot at saved legal position.
2D bounded adaptation: no suspension, slope solver, jump, cannon, machine gun, turret aiming, HP/shields or omni-gel repair.
Four fixed direction drawings only; no animated wheel rotation.
Other fleet entries remain existing media-scoped inspection references; no piloting of Nomad, Hammerhead, Normandy or Tempest added.
